data.text: Luke, I care about keeping our clinic open, but before we commit our catches and income, can you share confirmation from the clinic of the $60,000 shortfall and its deadline? Normally, I’d propose 10 tons each: that supports all five families and leaves enough fish to replenish the lake fully. If the emergency is confirmed and we agree to fund it through fishing, I’m willing to take 15 tons and donate the proceeds—but we need everyone’s agreement on both this month’s catches and next month’s 30-ton total. John, what do you think?
